nom: Erborian Centella Cleansing Gel with Centella Asiatica & Squalane

segments.oily: One reviewer with combination skin who develops oily breakouts speculates the gel might suit oily skin better, and a reviewer with dry patches suggests it may work better on oily skin than her own.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin most often report the gel dries their skin further or leaves it tight and with dry patches, though a few dry-skin users report no tightness and soft, hydrated results after double cleansing with the oil.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are split: some report the gel dried their skin out and caused breakouts, while others say it controlled excess oil, cleared blackheads and reduced redness without stripping the skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly describe the gel as mild, non-stinging and effective, including for eczema-prone and reactive skin, though one reviewer felt it was harsh on her delicate skin.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers report mixed results: one found it too effective at stripping oil for her drier mature skin and one found the scent harsh, while another with rosacea reports gentle cleansing and improved skin tone and softness.

concerns.aging: Reviewers noting age-related concerns report skin looking more luminous, firm, smoother and younger-looking after use; no negative reports on this concern specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the gel left their skin dry, tight or developed dry patches, including with regular use over time; many others explicitly report no tightness and soft, hydrated skin after use, so results diverge sharply.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with skin redness reports the gel helped somewhat but not fully; another with rosacea reports improved skin tone; one reviewer notes it does not sting or redden skin the way micellar water does.
concerns.barrier: A reviewer with eczema-prone and sensitive skin reports the gel and paired oil reduced sensitivity and reactivity, with no reports of barrier damage found elsewhere.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports smoother skin and fewer blemishes from sun exposure and diet; teenagers with blemishes are reported to love the product, per one reviewer.
concerns.blemishes: Reports diverge: some reviewers experienced multiple breakouts and dullness after starting the range, while others report their combination skin cleared of stubborn blackheads and breakouts, and one reports fewer breakouts overall.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily breakouts on combination skin reports no more excess oil after use; another suggests the gel removes oil very effectively, perhaps too effectively for mature or drier skin.

aspects.libelle: Product dispenses too quickly from pump
Small size lasts a long time
Gel texture pleasant, light and jelly-like

extraits.titre: It's a Little Drying Over Time
extraits.texte: I tried this cleanser in their sampler. The cleanser is okay. I've been using it because I thought it would help with my breakouts, but it's just been drying my skin out. I've developed dry patches where the breakouts are. Even on areas I don't have them as well. I have combonation skin. Someone with oliy skin may enjoy this facial cleanser. But this product is a pass for me.
I love Erborian products snd decided to have a go on this one, I have very dry skin and sadly this product makes my skin even drier. It might be good for other skin types but not for mine.

I have been suffering from skin outbreaks at 61 years old and red discolouration on my checks for several months, My normal creams, cleansers and make up seem to irritate my skin, I was recently advised to try Erborian, which I've been using for about one month and can already see improvements, so pleased with their products.

I have struggled through Alot of products to find something that was kind to my skin but also a good cleanser, this stuff is my go to product now, my skin feels clean and fresh, but light I don't feel like my skin is tight and and dry, I follow this with a few more of their products, absolutely amazing skin care range I have combination skin, and get really oily break outs, since using erborian I have no excess oils, my skin has improved within a week and its the only brand that has got rid of my stubborn black heads. I can't say anything about any of the products I have used except your skin will thank you.
I love this product. It smells amazing, is really mild for my sensitive skin but very effective.
I have mature skin suffering from rosacea. Thus gel is very gentle but thorough and with some of the other Eborian products for rosacea I'm seeing much better skin tone and softness again.
Used after the equally awesome oil cleanser, great for sensitive dry and eczema prone skin. You don't need much so the bottle lasts.
